assertion_observations.observation: Same identity and payload reused one route and delivery token with one local mock prepare.
Same intent with a changed payload failed closed as INTENT_CONFLICT.
Eight concurrent requests linearized to one route, token and local mock prepare.
Committed-result loss recovered the original route/token; blind recovery, early UUID and tampered checkpoint were rejected.
A new run_generation produced a new intent, route and delivery token.
Successor retry kept endpoint data outside identity, reused route/token and rejected endpoint_id identity pollution.
The local effect key stayed stable across generations and duplicate claim was rejected.
Exact three-module transitive closure was hash checked; omitted, extra, drifted, dynamic and forbidden imports were rejected.
Three fake transport/network attempts threw and no actual provider was bound.
The P2b normal scenario completed all seven assertions with normal_dispatch_attempts=0.
service_ready remained false; host-dependent claims were not evaluated or promoted.

limitations: Capability-limited cooperative VM, not an OS sandbox or malicious-code containment proof.
The injected provider is a local idempotent mock; Router CLI and actual chat transport are not bound.
Durable filesystem ownership remains deferred to P4.
Host authentication, real send, service_ready and full pnpm verify PASS are not claimed.
